rpt.crosscheck.page.title: Cross-report comparison of the same period
rpt.crosscheck.page.subtitle: Sets the reports of one period side by side (monthly, quarterly, steering meeting, HPM) and the frozen snapshot; a difference at the blocking level stops the release until someone other than the preparer has explained it.
rpt.crosscheck.rule.unverified: The tolerances, the blocking levels and the list of figures are starting values the business owner has not confirmed (D03); a tenant approves its own version in the governance rule screens.
rpt.crosscheck.coverage.nothing: No comparison was made: the reports are not all there, or they have no real figures. No difference does not mean the reports agree; see why comparisons were skipped below.
rpt.crosscheck.reports.title: Reports compared
rpt.crosscheck.reports.caption: Reports of the period and the frozen snapshot
rpt.crosscheck.findings.title: Differences
rpt.crosscheck.findings.none: Every comparison made agrees within the tolerance.
rpt.crosscheck.findings.noneCompared: No comparison was made, so nothing can be said to agree.
rpt.crosscheck.terms.caption: The numbers it is made of: report, source and time of each
rpt.crosscheck.path.title: Path to an explanation
rpt.crosscheck.path.regenerate_report: Generate the report {form} again from the snapshot in force, then compare again.
rpt.crosscheck.path.complete_month: Complete the report of {period}, then compare again.
rpt.crosscheck.path.assign_unit: Give a unit to the project rows that have none: {rows}.
rpt.crosscheck.path.check_source: Check the source figures of each number (the snapshot, the entries of the units).
rpt.crosscheck.path.explain: If the difference has a good reason, someone other than the preparer records an explanation below to allow the release.
rpt.crosscheck.explain.cannot: You cannot record this explanation: you lack the right, or you prepared a report that is part of the difference.
rpt.crosscheck.explain.problem.short: The reason needs at least 20 characters.
rpt.crosscheck.explain.problem.long: The reason has at most 2000 characters.
rpt.crosscheck.explain.problem.edges: The reason must not start or end with a blank.
rpt.crosscheck.error.self: The person who prepared a report that is part of the difference cannot explain it.
rpt.crosscheck.error.notFound: This difference is gone: the figures changed. Reload to see the differences now.
rpt.crosscheck.error.scope: You do not hold the right to explain over the whole corporation.
rpt.crosscheck.error.generic: The explanation was not recorded. Try again.
rpt.crosscheck.skipped.title: Comparisons skipped
rpt.crosscheck.skipped.caption: Comparisons without enough data, with the reason
rpt.crosscheck.gate.passed: No difference blocks the release of this draft.
rpt.crosscheck.gate.blocked: This draft cannot be issued yet: {count} blocking differences have no explanation.
rpt.common.error.crosscheckBlocked.text: Not issued: the reports of the same period do not agree and a blocking difference has no explanation by someone other than the preparer. Open the cross-report comparison to see it and explain it.
rpt.draft.crosscheck.open: See the comparison with the reports of the same period
